findings.title: WebSocket state_update snapshots overwrite initial HTTP 15-minute forecast with null and clear upstream HTTP error banners unconditionally
findings.body: [ui-dashboard/src/App.tsx:211-221] In App.tsx, onmessage treats every valid 'state_update' WebSocket message as a complete reading replacement via applyReading(nextReading) and clears httpError. As documented in claudedocs/design/ui-dashboard-audit-2026-10-30.md:120-125, the backend state_update event does not include predicted_load_15min, so any forecast obtained from GET /api/adhd-state drops to null ('unknown') on the first live socket event. Additionally, setHttpError(null) clears partial upstream error warnings from the initial GET even if the socket update also omits those fields. OPERATOR: decision pending (round 6).
